# Harbor task fixtures

Public tasks from the [Harbor](https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor) registry, vendored unchanged to prove that
flightdeck loads Harbor's format without a converter (docs/tasks.md). Not team data.

| Directory | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hello-world/` | Harbor's registry dataset `hello-world` 1.0: `harbor-framework/harbor` `examples/tasks/hello-world` at `62db0c1fd003807ec2c64cea91f474f9bacc67d6` (2026-10-16) | Apache-2.0 (Harbor) |

Refresh by copying the directory again from a newer Harbor commit and updating the row. Prefer trivial tasks:
benchmark tasks carry canary strings and shouldn't be republished.
